objections_raised: Rorty's overemphasis on liberation ignores background
Rorty's focus on literature neglects real relationships
Radical freedom leads to nihilism or narcissism

summary_of_core_decisions: The essay builds a dialectical argument: presents two opposing senses of freedom (liberation vs boundaries), traces their historical development, critiques Rorty's one-sided liberation, then synthesizes them through a dialogical self that respects both. The film 'The Legend of 1900' serves as a recurring illustration of the synthesis.
